english.note: Use this for someone exceptionally skilled, especially in a practical activity, game, or specialized ability.
Use this as the everyday all-purpose noun for someone highly skilled at a subject or activity.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone exceptionally skilled, including a virtuoso performer.
Use this for someone exceptionally skilled at an activity, especially in an informal evaluation, rather than simply someone whose job is professional.
Use this when “wizard” means someone exceptionally skilled in a particular field.
Use this colloquial noun for someone highly skilled at a particular task or activity.
